verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview lists "workflows" as a built-in capability, and a community note confirms Workflows is an Enterprise-Edition feature removed from Cal.diy, so a native workflow engine exists. Nothing in the evidence says what those workflows do: email or SMS reminders, timing relative to the booking, or follow-ups. Zapier automations and webhook triggers are third-party or developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation that workflows send email/SMS reminders before meetings, post-meeting follow-up sequences, configurable timing/triggers, any no-show reduction evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
